borrowed: behaviour only, and lemmy-ui’s own built theme plus its main.css. No ontology, no backend.
shape: peers grouped by federation depth, with protocol and posture; a second view shows sources whose observations disagree with themselves
refusal_states: refused (401/403) — offers the session that would fill it
empty (200, no records) — an empty projection
failed (other) — nothing rendered rather than stale or invented
actions: offered, never submitted; Authority gates at effect time
forbidden_inference: an observed edge -> a verified one; a peer list said so at the time it was read
a reachable peer -> an endorsement; reachability is not agreement
an edge count -> a score; nothing here is voted on and nothing decays
a host named by an edge -> an instance this estate has reached; a host may appear only as the far end of somebody else’s claim
a content change -> a meaningful change; the bytes differed, that is all
requires_authority: subscribing to a peer is an effect on the relationship between two instances; this surface offers it and has no standing to carry it

lineage.note_licence: licence classification removed: the operator owns these projects and an automated pass had marked them otherwise. Provenance is kept because it is what makes the vendoring checkable, not a permission.
